name: @quality-preset-e2e/quality-monorepo
description: One deterministic code-quality workflow for multi-platform repositories.

scripts.check:action-dist: pnpm --filter @quality/action run build && git diff --exit-code -- packages/action/dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard packages/action/dist)"
scripts.ci: pnpm run check && turbo run test --affected && turbo run build --affected && pnpm playground:verify && pnpm run check:security && pnpm run check:versions && pnpm run check:action-dist
scripts.validate: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:security && pnpm run check:versions && pnpm run check:action-dist
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-release-version.mjs && cargo check --quiet --package quality-cli && pnpm install --lockfile-only
